newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolian airliner crashes on edge of Gobi desert.
newsitem.headline: Mongolian airliner crashes on edge of Gobi desert.

text.p: A Mongolian airliner crashed on Tuesday while on a flight from the capital, Ulan Bator, to the town of Mandelgobi in the Central Gobi district, an Ulan Bator airport official said.
He refused to say how many people were on board the commercial flight that had been due to land in Mandelgobi at around 12:00 p.m.
"We have received information of a plane crash," the official said by telephone from the airport control tower in Ulan Bator.
A team of officials had already left Ulan Bator for the crash site, he said, but refused to give further details.
A relative of one of the passengers told Reuters many people were believed to be on board the plane.
